'''Shiraō Shrine''' (白皇神社 / 白王神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}. 

* {{ill|Shiraō Shrine (Nishitosa Egawa, Shimanto)|ja|白皇神社 (四万十市西土佐江川)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiraō Shrine (Nishitosa Egawa, Shimanto)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Nishitosa Egawa, Shimanto City, Kōchi Prefecture.

* {{ill|Shiraō Shrine (Hassenzū, Shimanto Town)|ja|白皇神社 (四万十町八千数)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiraō Shrine (Hassenzū, Shimanto Town)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Hassenzū (八千数), Shimanto Town, Takaoka District, Kōchi Prefecture.
